_about: HexFW (Flipper Zero firmware) download page at /flipper/. Releases are added by the firmware release pipeline (a copy of each build's release.json) after the owner approves them. The build mirrors each listed .tgz onto the site so Flipper Lab can install it (needs CORS, which GitHub Pages sends). Leave releases empty to show the 'in development' state.
name: HexFW

notes: HexFW desktop: two original vaporwave idle scenes replace the stock animations (Sunset Drive: palm, striped sun and shimmering sea; Grid Run: HEX mark over a scrolling grid).
Firmware reports itself as HexMods to qFlipper, Flipper Lab and the mobile app.
Everything else is the official 1.5.1 firmware, so apps from the official catalogue keep working.
